Function SortSnapshot() As String
On Error GoTo Failed
Dim s As Sort,f As SortField,r As Range,v As Variant,out As String
Set s=ActiveSheet.Sort
out="header=" & s.Header & ";case=" & s.MatchCase & ";orientation=" & s.Orientation & ";method=" & s.SortMethod & ";fields=" & s.SortFields.Count
For Each f In s.SortFields
Set r=f.Key
out=out & "[" & r.Address & ":" & f.Order & ":" & f.DataOption & "]"
Next
out=out & ";rng="
On Error Resume Next
Set r=s.Rng
If Err.Number<>0 Then
out=out & "ERR:" & Err.Number
Err.Clear
Else
out=out & r.Address
End If
On Error GoTo Failed
SortSnapshot=out
Exit Function
Failed:
SortSnapshot=out & ";ERR:" & Err.Number & ":" & Err.Description
End Function
Function Prepare() As String
Dim w As Worksheet,s As Sort
Set w=ActiveSheet
w.Name="Data"
w.Range("J1:K1").Value=Array("Key","Value")
w.Range("J2:J5").Value=3
w.Range("J3").Value=1:w.Range("J4").Value=2
Set s=w.Sort
s.SetRange w.Range("J1:K5")
s.Header=2
s.SortFields.Add w.Range("J2:J5"),0,1
Prepare=SortSnapshot()
End Function

probes.name: loaded-replace-range-fields
probes.setup_source:
Function SortSnapshot() As String
On Error GoTo Failed
Dim s As Sort,f As SortField,r As Range,v As Variant,out As String
Set s=ActiveSheet.Sort
out="header=" & s.Header & ";case=" & s.MatchCase & ";orientation=" & s.Orientation & ";method=" & s.SortMethod & ";fields=" & s.SortFields.Count
For Each f In s.SortFields
Set r=f.Key
out=out & "[" & r.Address & ":" & f.Order & ":" & f.DataOption & "]"
Next
out=out & ";rng="
On Error Resume Next
Set r=s.Rng
If Err.Number<>0 Then
out=out & "ERR:" & Err.Number
Err.Clear
Else
out=out & r.Address
End If
On Error GoTo Failed
SortSnapshot=out
Exit Function
Failed:
SortSnapshot=out & ";ERR:" & Err.Number & ":" & Err.Description
End Function
Function Prepare() As String
Dim w As Worksheet,s As Sort
Set w=ActiveSheet
w.Name="Data"
w.Range("J1:K1").Value=Array("Key","Value")
w.Range("J2:J5").Value=3
w.Range("J3").Value=1:w.Range("J4").Value=2
Set s=w.Sort
s.SetRange w.Range("J1:K5")
s.Header=2
s.SortFields.Add w.Range("J2:J5"),0,1
Prepare=SortSnapshot()
End Function

Function Probe() As String
On Error GoTo Failed
Dim s As Sort
Set s=ActiveSheet.Sort
s.SetRange ActiveSheet.Range("M1:N5")
s.SortFields.Clear
s.SortFields.Add ActiveSheet.Range("N2:N5"),0,2
Probe=SortSnapshot()
